_comment: Stormwood's hand-authored Tier 3 harvest catalogue. Positions are realm-local X/Z and StormwoodHarvestRuntime samples StormwoodWorld.ground_height_at() before mounting each HarvestNode, so nodes stay grounded against the installed terrain. Each id is stable and is carried to HarvestNode as its order identity.
excluded_reason: Sparkfur is an encounter reward. It has no harvest site, preserving the no-hunting/no-butchering rule.
